What Is Included

Everything done for you.

Every rental plan covers the full service, not just the hardware. You should not have to worry about anything.

01

Professional Trap and Installation

We supply and professionally install your Biogents or Mosqitter Grand trap in the optimal location for maximum coverage. No tools, no effort on your part.

02

Monthly CO₂ Delivery

Fresh CO₂ tanks delivered to your door every month by our all-electric EV fleet. We swap the empty, you never run out, the trap never stops.

03

All Maintenance and Repairs

If anything needs attention, a worn catch net, a component issue, seasonal repositioning, we handle it. Equipment is our responsibility, not yours.

04

Attractant Refills

For Mosqitter Grand rentals, monthly Mosqilure scent attractant replacements are included. The four-way attraction system stays at peak performance all season.

05

App Setup and Support

For Mosqitter Grand rentals, we configure the app, walk you through the controls, and provide ongoing support. You will always be able to reach us.

06

Seasonal Adjustments

Mosquito pressure shifts with Austin's seasons. We adjust trap placement and settings to keep coverage optimal year-round at no extra charge.

Common Questions

We have heard every concern.

Will it actually work on my property?

CO₂ trapping has been scientifically validated across millions of deployments worldwide, with up to 93% bite reduction in independent studies. If our free consultation determines your property is not a good fit for a trap, we will tell you. We would rather be honest than sign you up for something that will not perform.

How long before I notice a difference?

Most customers notice significantly fewer bites within the first 7 to 10 days. Within two to three weeks, the mosquito breeding cycle begins to collapse, meaning you are not just repelling mosquitoes, you are reducing the total population around your property.

What if I want to cancel?

We operate month-to-month with no long-term contracts. If you want to stop, just let us know. We will come collect the equipment with no penalty or hassle. We keep customers because the service works, not because they are locked in.

Is it safe around my kids, dogs, and garden?

Completely. CO₂ traps use zero pesticides or sprays. They target only blood-seeking female mosquitoes. Bees, butterflies, pets, and children are entirely safe around both the Biogents and Mosqitter Grand traps at all times.

What happens if the trap breaks or needs service?

It is our equipment, our problem. Any maintenance, repairs, or replacements are covered as part of your rental. You will never pay extra for a service visit. Just contact us and we handle it, typically within 24 to 48 hours.

Do I need to do anything day-to-day?

Nothing. The trap runs continuously and silently. Your CO₂ arrives monthly. The only thing you might do is check the catch net occasionally, or opt into the full-service rental where we handle that too.
